extraction_warnings: This is an Executive Agency AER (not a Legislative AER). Section I lists agency decisions with active advocacy (Governor, Public Works Commission, Transportation) rather than bills/resolutions. The LobbyingPosition schema has no dedicated field for agency name or decision/rule number; agency name was placed in general_issue_area and decision description in the description field. The Decision/Rule # column was blank for all rows, so no data was lost there.

Section I contains four agency-decision rows across three agencies (Governor × 2, Public Works Commission × 1, Transportation × 1). Each has been emitted as a separate LobbyingPosition since they represent distinct disclosed advocacy topics.
Section II states 'No expenditures'; no LobbyingExpenditure rows emitted.
Reporting period label is 'Jan-Apr25'. Ohio Executive AERs cover January–April; start date set to 2025-01-01 and end date to 2025-04-30 by convention. Exact dates not stated in source.
